rule: GO if for at least one combination of feature in {clip, dino}, m in {1, 2} and eps in {0.005, 0.01}: mean over order seeds of (c) >= X AND mean over order seeds of (d)[1:1] >= Y. Otherwise NO-GO. Not to be changed after the main run.

definitions.c: P(nominated AND NOT seeded | near) in the (ID dev + near dev) stream; seeded = S_arrival < beta (0.3); nominated = d(x) > q_eps
definitions.d_1to1: P(novel | near) / (P(novel | near) + P(novel | ID)), both rates from the (ID dev + near dev) stream
definitions.aggregation: arithmetic mean over the order seeds
